title: Push Past the Break
setup: Black's c-pawn is hitting your pawn on d4. Your big center is what cramps Black, and a trade would hand the room back.
hint: Defending d4 still lets Black trade on it. Where can that pawn go so the c-pawn has nothing left to hit?
explanation:
## The Idea

With more space, avoid trades: every swap gives the cramped side room. {{d5}} steps past the c-pawn instead of trading with it, and now White's pawns on c4, d5 and e5 take c6, d6, e6 and f6 away from Black's pieces.

{{dxc5}} does the opposite. The queens come off with check, the knight on b6 jumps to a4, and Black is the one with room to play.
